body:
# 🛡️ **ChunkProtector** 🚀

**ChunkProtector** is a high-performance, **Server-Side ONLY** administrative protection matrix for **Minecraft 1.21.x, 26.1.x, and 26.2.x**. It provides granular flag-based territory control with an intuitive chest GUI—no client mods required. 🔌✨

### Supported Versions

| Version | Java | Status |
|---------|------|--------|
| 1.21.x | 21 | ✅ Full support |
| 26.1.x | 25 | ✅ Full support |
| 26.2.x | 25 | ✅ Full support |

---

### 🛠️ **Purpose & Function**
The core mission of this project is to give server administrators **total control** over their world's protected zones through a **Digital Flag System**. 🌌

- **Stop the Grief:** Instead of relying on clunky command-based flag management, admins can now open a visual **9x3 chest menu** and toggle protections with a single click. 🧹
- **Instant Enforcement:** Every flag is enforced server-side via Mixins—PvP, TNT, explosions, projectiles, fire spread, liquid flow, mob spawning, flight, and more are intercepted the moment they touch a protected chunk. 💨🔥

---

### ✨ **Key Features**

| Flag | Description | Default |
|------|-------------|---------|
| 🗡️ PvP Enabled | Allow player vs player combat | OFF |
| 🧱 Admin Edit Only | Only admins can place/break blocks | ON |
| 💎 Ender Pearls | Allow ender pearl teleportation | OFF |
| 💥 TNT Explosions | Allow TNT explosions | OFF |
| 🌊 Liquid Flow | Allow liquids to flow into area | OFF |
| 🏹 Projectiles | Block arrows, snowballs, etc. | ON |
| 🪶 No Flight Zone | Disable flight in this area | ON |
| ⚔️ No Fight Zone | Disable ALL combat in this area | ON |
| 👾 Mob Spawning | Allow mob spawning | OFF |
| ☠️ Wither/Creeper Grief | Allow wither/creeper block damage | OFF |
| 🧭 Hostile Despawn | Despawn hostile mobs near players | 8 blocks |
| 🔥 Magma Damage | Disable sulfur cube damage | ON |
| 🔥 Fire Spread | Prevent fire from spreading | ON |
| 🌱 Crop Trample | Prevent crops being trampled | ON |
| 📦 Item Drop | Prevent item dropping | OFF |
| 🚂 Vehicle Entry | Prevent entering vehicles/boats | OFF |
| 🌾 Animal Breeding | Prevent animal breeding | OFF |

- 🚀 **18 Configurable Flags** — Toggle each protection live from the GUI
- 📡 **100% Server-Side** — No client mods required. Vanilla players are fully protected. 🍦
- 🛡️ **Chest GUI Menu** — Intuitive 27-slot interface with colored ON/OFF indicators and descriptions
- ⚖️ **Ultra-Lightweight** — Pure Fabric Mixins with zero dependencies and near-zero CPU footprint 🧠
- 🧹 **No Fabric API Required** — Just Fabric Loader. Drop the JAR and go.
- 🗺️ **Chunk Selection Tools** — Admin Stick + Claim Shovel for defining areas visually
- 🔄 **Auto-Merge** — Adjacent chunks merge automatically into contiguous protected regions
- 🛡️ **Buffer Zone** — Configurable safety border to prevent edge-case exploits

---

### 🎮 **How to Use**
- **Step 1:** Give yourself tools with `/chunkprotector tool stick` (selection) and `/chunkprotector tool shovel` (claim). 💬
- **Step 2:** Right-click blocks to select chunks, then run `/chunkprotector area create myArea`. 📦
- **Step 3:** Open the flag menu with `/chunkprotector area myArea menu`. ❌
- **Step 4:** Click any flag item to toggle it — green glow means active. ⚡

```
/chunkprotector info          — Show commands
/chunkprotector menu           — Flag GUI for current chunk
/chunkprotector area <id> menu — Flag GUI for specific area
```

---

> *Built for administrators who demand granular territory control and lag-free protection enforcement. Every flag is enforced instantly, server-wide, with zero client overhead.* 🌍💎
